name: Assay — Verify an Agent Commitment
description: Independent verification for onchain agents. Given an intent hash, reports whether the agent committed to that action onchain BEFORE it executed, and returns the verifier's full public verdict record — how many of its executions were VERIFIED, DIVERGENT, UNPROVEN or NOT_EXECUTED. Reads contract state directly; no trust in the executor's own report.
_comment_enabled: Workflows are created dormant. A listed workflow that is not enabled answers callers with 503, so publishing without this is publishing nothing. Safe here because the trigger is Manual: enabling makes it callable, it does not start a schedule.

data.label: Check Intent Commitment
data.description: Was this exact action committed onchain before it was executed? An execution with no prior commitment cannot be held to anything.

data.label: Read Verifier Record
data.description: The verifier's public tally. A verifier that has only ever reported VERIFIED is itself a finding.
